run_prompt_evaluation_ifeval: run prompt evaluation on the IFEval dataset using baseline or evolved prompts
run_prompt_evaluation_hover: run prompt evaluation on the HoVer dataset to measure claim verification accuracy
run_prompt_evaluation_hotpotqa: run prompt evaluation on the HotpotQA dataset for reading comprehension accuracy
run_prompt_evaluation_all: run prompt evaluation on all GEPA benchmark datasets at once with one command
run_prompt_evaluation_compare: run prompt evaluation comparing evolved prompts against baseline results for improvement
